verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS back-office platform that holds sensitive company and financial data, so data-residency choice is a fair question for it. The evidence never mentions choosing a storage region or data residency. The state selection on the compliance dashboard concerns business registration jurisdiction, not where data is stored, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
